title: Recording Timer Leak Fix
requirements: Cancel RecordingViewModel.startTimer()'s spawned Task on all teardown paths, not only on stop(): add a teardown() method on RecordingViewModel that calls cancelTimer() (and flushes any in-flight transcription if present)
Call viewModel.teardown() from RecordingView.onDisappear so sheet dismissal, app termination, or non-stop dismissal cancels the timer Task
Store the timer Task handle in a private(set) var timerTask: Task<Void, Never>? rather than fire-and-forget — no unstructured spawn
cancelTimer() must guard for nil; setting timerTask = nil after cancel to avoid double-cancel
Log end-of-lifecycle: after teardown, the spawned Task has completed and is not retained in the heap
acceptance_criteria: After closing the recording sheet at any state, no Task related to the old view-model remains in the heap
50 start-stop cycle with immediate dismiss leaves no leaked Tasks (verifiable via memory-graph heuristic or a deterministic cancel-timeout test)
